## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Intentional teaching sinks and vulnerable/fixed behavior are preserved or explicitly discussed.
- [ ] Platform authority, owner/session/reset/sibling isolation and accurate objective credit remain intact.
- [ ] Applicable catalog, hints, solutions, admin controls and progress changes stay synchronized.
- [ ] Database changes are forward-only and preserve instructor/learner data.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, generated output or personal agent plans are included.
- [ ] Documentation and migration/upgrade notes are updated where needed.
